propositions: Canonical contributor guidance hardcodes a specific bot identity (Joe Oakhart) instead of instructing contributors to sign with their own configured git identity.

Documentation files AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/rebar.md, and CONTRIBUTING.md contain contradictory DCO sign-off instructions: CONTRIBUTING.md requires real contributor name/email while other files prescribe a specific bot identity.

Guidance must be made identity-neutral by removing personal bot sign-off prescriptions from contributor-facing docs and retaining Joe Oakhart identity only in automation-scoped paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/fixtures/).
A deterministic git grep-based lint check must be added to the build to prevent future reintroduction of hardcoded personal sign-off strings in contributor guidance files.
